mapper.select: INSERT INTO external_task (tenant_id, hotel_id, task_type, channel, idempotency_key, payload, status, max_attempts, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{hotelId}, #{taskType}, #{channel}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{payload}::jsonb, 'PENDING', #{maxAttempts}, now()) RETURNING task_id

WITH claimed AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT e.task_id FROM external_task e WHERE (e.status = 'PENDING' AND e.next_attempt_at <= now()) OR (e.status = 'RUNNING' AND e.lease_until <= now()) ORDER BY e.next_attempt_at, e.task_id LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE external_task t SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), updated_at = now() FROM claimed WHERE t.task_id = claimed.task_id RETURNING t.task_id, t.tenant_id, t.hotel_id, t.task_type, t.channel, t.idempotency_key, t.payload::text AS payload, t.status, t.attempts, t.max_attempts, t.next_attempt_at, t.lease_token, t.result_ref, t.last_error
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_task_attempt (task_id, attempt_no, started_at, finished_at, outcome, error_class, detail, result_ref) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{attemptNo}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{outcome}, #{errorClass}, #{detail}, #{resultRef})
mapper.update: UPDATE external_task SET attempts = GREATEST(attempts, #{attemptNo}), last_error_class = #{errorClass}, last_error = #{detail}, updated_at = now() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

UPDATE external_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_ref = #{resultRef}, last_error_class = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE external_task SET status = 'PENDING', last_error_class = #{errorClass}, last_error = #{detail}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE external_task SET status = 'FAILED', last_error_class = #{errorClass}, last_error = #{detail}, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE external_task SET status = 'MANUAL_REVIEW', last_error_class = #{errorClass}, last_error = #{detail}, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE external_task SET status = 'DEAD', last_error_class = #{errorClass}, last_error = #{detail}, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE external_task SET status = 'PENDING', next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{reason}, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, tenant_id, hotel_id, task_type, channel, idempotency_key, payload::text AS payload, status, attempts, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, lease_token, result_ref, last_error FROM external_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE external_task SET status = #{status}, result_ref = #{resultRef}, last_error = #{detail}, completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
mapper.select: SELECT attempt_no, started_at, finished_at, outcome, error_class, detail, result_ref FROM external_task_attempt WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY attempt_no

SELECT task_id, tenant_id, hotel_id, task_type, channel, idempotency_key, payload::text AS payload, status, attempts, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, lease_token, result_ref, last_error FROM external_task WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY next_attempt_at, task_id LIMIT #{limit}
